statistiche.azzera_testo: From now on, events are no longer linked to the earlier ones. With the beta licence, the serial number stays in the events.
statistiche.cambia: You can change your mind at any time from the ⋯ menu, under “Usage statistics”, and delete the collected data there.
statistiche.cancella_server: We also ask the server to delete the data linked to this code.
statistiche.cancella_testo: The statistics log on this computer is deleted. Your choice stays: if statistics are on, collection starts again from zero.
statistiche.cartella_non_valida: The chosen folder is no longer there: choose another one.
statistiche.chiedi_testo: If you say yes, Impaginatore records how you use it, so we can see what works and what doesn't before release. By default it records nothing.
statistiche.chiedi_titolo: This is a private beta: will you help us improve it by sharing how you use the program?
statistiche.codice_nessuno: No installation code: it is created when you turn statistics on.
statistiche.dove_invio: Every item is first written to a log on this computer, which you can read (“What I share”), and then sent to {server}.
statistiche.dove_manuale: For now the data stays on this computer, in a log you can read (“What I share”). You send it to us yourself, whenever you like, with “Export statistics…”.
statistiche.dove_registro: The log is in the folder {cartella}
statistiche.grazie: Thank you: usage statistics are on.
statistiche.invio_manuale: Sending: none. The data leaves the computer only if you export it.
statistiche.niente_da_esportare: There is nothing to export yet: the statistics log is empty.
statistiche.no: Photos and images; names of files, folders, albums and clients; paths; album text; EXIF data; faces. For errors it records the type and the place in the program, never the message.
statistiche.registro_testo: The log lines exactly as they are written: this is everything Impaginatore has recorded and might share.
statistiche.scegli_cartella: Choose the folder to save the statistics in
statistiche.scelta_vero_falso: The statistics choice must be yes or no.
statistiche.seriale: The serial number links the data to your beta licence, and so to you: it is personal data, and we handle it as the privacy notice explains.
statistiche.si_computer: the computer: system and version, language, memory, number of processors, window and screen size;
statistiche.si_errori: errors that occur: the type and the place in the program;
statistiche.si_funzioni: the features you use, how often and how long they take (for example: draft proposed in 2 seconds);
statistiche.si_id: a random code for this installation, which you can renew, and the serial number of your beta licence.
statistiche.si_numeri: album figures: how many photos and spreads, the size in centimetres, the export format;
